mainEntity.name: What is the maximum size allowed for an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Detached ADUs are typically limited to 1,200 square feet (or local ordinance limits), while attached ADUs are often capped at 50% of the primary home's living area or 1,200 sq ft, whichever is smaller.
